title: Astronaut float kyun karte hain?
description: Season 2 Episode 1: Astronauts float because they are falling *with* their spaceship — not because gravity is missing.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 7 (g at height) + Ch 4 (free fall)
exam_focus: JEE/NEET: variation of g with altitude, weightlessness in orbit
concept: Astronauts float because they are falling *with* their spaceship — not because gravity is missing.
on_screen_cues: "ISS = 400 km up" → "g ≈ 8.7 m/s² (≈ 90%)" → "FREE FALL" → "NCERT XI · Ch 7 Gravitation"
pinned_comment: Lift ki rassi toot jaaye aur tum last second JUMP karo — bachoge? 😏 Comment karo, answer Script 8 mein.
suggested_titles: "Space mein gravity nahi hoti? WRONG 🚀" / "Astronaut float kyun karte hain? Asli reason"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [confidently] Chintu, space mein gravity nahi hoti, isliye astronaut float karte hain. Right?
Chintu: [deadpan] Wrong!
Gudiya: [surprised] Kya?! Sab yahi bolte hain!
Chintu: [excited] Space Station sirf 400 kilometre upar hai. Wahan gravity Earth ki almost 90 PERCENT hai!
Gudiya: [confused] 90 percent?! Toh woh float kaise kar rahe hain?
Chintu: [mischievously] Kyunki woh float nahi kar rahe... woh GIR rahe hain!
Gudiya: [gasps] Gir rahe hain?!
Chintu: [excited] Haan! Station bhi gir raha hai, astronaut bhi gir raha hai. Dono saath saath gir rahe hain, isliye floating lagta hai!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Jaise lift ki rassi toot jaaye... toh andar sab float karenge?
Chintu: [elated] EXACTLY! Isko bolte hain FREE FALL!
Gudiya: [curious] Lekin agar woh gir rahe hain... toh zameen pe kyun nahi aate?
Chintu: [whispers] Kyunki woh itni tezi se side mein bhaag rahe hain... ki zameen miss ho jaati hai.
Gudiya: [excited] Miss ho jaati hai?! Matlab?!
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
